title: Como consider new striker after Kean injury problem
snippet: The unexpected Moise Kean setback could prompt a change of plan for Como in January,...
body: ROTTERDAM, NETHERLANDS - OCTOBER 14: Cesc Fabregas, Manager of Como 1907, speaks to Martin Baturina and Alex Valle of Como 1907 during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between Feyenoord and Como 1907 at De Kuip on October 14, 2026 in Rotterdam, Netherlands. (Photo by Lars Baron/Getty Images) The unexpected Moise Kean setback could prompt a change of plan for Como in January, as they might need to invest in another centre-forward with Sergio Camello of Rayo Vallecano mentioned. The Lariani already spent a lot of money convincing Fiorentina to sell Kean in the summer for €35m plus up to another €5m in add-ons. However, after just four competitive appearances, he has been struggling with a recurring leg injury and might be out for a while longer. GENOA, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 04: Assane Diao of Como celebrates scoring his team’s fourth goal with Moise Kean during the Serie A match between Genoa CFC and Como 1907 at Stadio Luigi Ferraris on September 04, 2026 in Genoa, Italy. (Photo by Simone Arveda/Getty Images) Como released a statement confirming that Kean is undergoing further medical assessment following an issue in training, but the fear is he will be out until at least 2027. That leaves Tasos Douvikas as the only available centre-forward, with Nico Paz potentially moving into a False 9 role on occasion. summary_en: Como may look for another striker in January following a setback for Moise Kean.

title: Official: Kean undergoing new medical assessment after Como setback
snippet: Como have released a statement confirming Italy striker Moise Kean is ‘undergoing further medical assessment’...
body: ZENICA, BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA - MARCH 31: Moise Kean of Italy celebrates after scoring his team's opening goal during the FIFA World Cup 2026 European Qualifiers KO play-offs match between Bosnia and Herzegovina and Italy at Stadion Bilino Polje on March 31, 2026 in Zenica, Bosnia and Herzegovina. (Photo by Getty Images/Getty Images) Como have released a statement confirming Italy striker Moise Kean is ‘undergoing further medical assessment’ after an incident in training, as his return to action is further postponed. The centre-forward has been struggling with a recurring tibia issue for many months, going back to his time at Fiorentina before the summer transfer to Como. He played through pain, returned and had relapses, the most recent appearance coming in early October for Italy in the Nations League. Kean had been given a recovery time of five weeks after specialist treatment, but there were reports of another setback in training. GENOA, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 04: Assane Diao of Como celebrates scoring his team’s fourth goal with Moise Kean during the Serie A match between Genoa CFC and Como 1907 at Stadio Luigi Ferraris on September 04, 2026 in Genoa, Italy. (Photo by Simone Arveda/Getty Images) “Following an issue during training, Moise Kean is undergoing further medical assessment,” confirmed a club statement this evening. “Our priority is supporting his recovery. summary_en: Como said Moise Kean is having further medical checks after a training incident related to a recurring tibia problem, delaying his return.

title: Lyon midfielder Tyler Morton sidelined until February following surgery
snippet: Olympique Lyonnais’ Tyler Morton (24) will be sidelined until February, the club have announced in a medical statement. Having suffered from recurring pain in his left adductor, the English midfielder…
body: Olympique Lyonnais’ Tyler Morton (24) will be sidelined until February, the club have announced in a medical statement . Having suffered from recurring pain in his left adductor, the English midfielder took advantage of the international break to undergo surgery and begin his rehabilitation. This is a huge blow for OL, who have already been without Loïs Openda (26) for a month, as well as Pavel Šulc (25) – who is also expected to return in February – and Mohamed Ouedraogo (23), who suffered a cruciate ligament tear in his right knee in early October. Having joined Lyon from Liverpool in the summer of 2025, Morton quickly established himself as a key figure in Lyon’s midfield. Having started 12 of his 14 appearances in all competitions this season (scoring one goal), the Englishman had missed OL’s last three matches – against Angers SCO, Real Sociedad and Stade Brestois 29 – due to groin pain. GFFN | Léo Aschi
summary_en: Lyon midfielder Tyler Morton had surgery for a recurring adductor problem and will be out until February.
